feature: LMS.CertificateService — Phase 1 service #8: issue PDF certificates on CourseCompleted, anonymous verify, admin revoke.

tasks.title: Add CertificateIssued event to LMS.Contracts
tasks.spec: Create src/LMS.Contracts/Certificate/CertificateIssued.cs as a sealed record with shape (Guid EventId, Guid TenantId, Guid CertificateId, Guid UserId, Guid CourseId, string CertificateNumber, Guid VerificationCode, DateTimeOffset IssuedAt, DateTimeOffset OccurredAt). XML doc-comment must call out idempotency key = EventId. Update docs/events.md routing table: add row 'CertificateIssued | CertificateService | NotificationWorker'. Do NOT modify any other event. Resolve Open Decision #3 by documenting Phase-1 vs Phase-4 split (CertificateIssued vs CredentialIssued) in the event-record XML doc.

tasks.title: Scaffold CertificateService 4-project layout
tasks.spec: Use the /scaffold-service playbook. Create LMS.CertificateService.{Domain,Infrastructure,Api,Migrator} under src/services/LMS.CertificateService/. Domain references LMS.SharedKernel only. Infrastructure references Domain + LMS.Contracts + LMS.ServiceDefaults + EF Core + Npgsql + MassTransit + MassTransit.EntityFrameworkCore + QuestPDF + QRCoder + Azure.Storage.Blobs. Api references Infrastructure + LMS.ServiceDefaults + Aspire.Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL + Aspire.Azure.Storage.Blobs + Microsoft.FeatureManagement.AspNetCore. Migrator references Infrastructure + LMS.ServiceDefaults. Add all four to LMS.slnx. Set TreatWarningsAsErrors. Empty Program.cs in Api with AddServiceDefaults + MapDefaultEndpoints stubs only — endpoints come in T7. Migrator IHostedService skeleton runs context.Database.MigrateAsync once. Port 5108 in launchSettings.json.

tasks.title: Domain: Certificate entity, DTOs, abstractions
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md sections 2, 5, 7. In LMS.CertificateService.Domain: Certificate entity (TenantEntity-derived) with CertificateNumber, TemplateId?, PdfStorageKey, RevokedAt, RevocationReason, Phase-4 placeholders; owned BlockchainAnchor; AnchorStatus enum. ICertificatePdfRenderer + CertificateRenderProfile record. IPdfStorage interface. CertificateNumberGenerator static helper (CERT-{yyyy}-{Crockford-base32 8-char of Id}). DTOs: CertificateDto, CertificateVerificationDto, RevokeCertificateRequest. FluentValidation validator for RevokeCertificateRequest (Reason: non-empty, <= 500). Unit tests covering CertificateNumberGenerator format + 10k uniqueness + validator.

tasks.title: Initial EF migration for certificates schema
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md section 2. CertificateDbContext in Infrastructure/Persistence/CertificateDbContext.cs with global TenantId filter via reflection over TenantEntity descendants, OwnsOne(BlockchainAnchor), xmin row-version, snake_case naming, schema 'certificates'. Indexes: filtered unique (TenantId, UserId, CourseId) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL; unique (TenantId, CertificateNumber); unique (VerificationCode); (TenantId, UserId, IssuedAt DESC). Add MassTransit EF outbox tables in same schema. Generate migration 20260427_001_InitialCertificateSchema. Wire Migrator IHostedService to apply migrations on startup.

tasks.title: Infrastructure: Azure Blob storage + QuestPDF renderer
tasks.spec: Implement IPdfStorage as AzureBlobPdfStorage using BlobServiceClient + container 'certificate-pdfs', key '{tenantId}/{certificateId}.pdf'. Implement ICertificatePdfRenderer as QuestPdfCertificateRenderer: A4 landscape, header (issuer name + tenant logo placeholder), body (learner name + 'has completed' + course title), footer (CertificateNumber, IssuedAt, verification URL + QR via QRCoder). Set QuestPDF.Settings.License = LicenseType.Community in DI extension AddCertificateInfrastructure(IServiceCollection, IConfiguration). Wire MassTransit (UseEntityFrameworkOutbox<CertificateDbContext>, retry intervals 1/5/30s). Smoke unit test: renderer returns byte[] starting with %PDF-.

tasks.title: CourseCompletedConsumer (idempotent issuance + outbox publish)
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md section 3 publish flow. CourseCompletedConsumer in Infrastructure/Consumers/. Inbox dedupe relies on filtered unique index (TenantId, UserId, CourseId) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL — catch DbUpdateException unique-violation as no-op. Steps: set CurrentTenantId from msg.TenantId, query existing active cert, if none generate Id+CertificateNumber+VerificationCode, render via ICertificatePdfRenderer with placeholder profile (Learner / Course / TenantDisplayName from config), upload via IPdfStorage, insert row, outbox-publish CertificateIssued, SaveChangesAsync. Single transaction. Reads VerificationBaseUrl + DefaultIssuerName from IConfiguration.

tasks.title: Api: endpoints + Program.cs + tenant middleware + verify (anonymous)
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md section 7. Map endpoints in CertificateEndpoints.MapCertificateEndpoints(WebApplication): GET /api/certificates/{id}, GET /api/certificates/me (optional ?courseId), GET /api/certificates/{id}/pdf (FileStreamResult application/pdf via IPdfStorage.OpenReadAsync; 410 if revoked; owner-or-admin authz), POST /api/certificates/{id}/revoke (admin-only via ctx.IsInRole), GET /verify/{verificationCode} (anonymous; uses _db.Certificates.IgnoreQueryFilters().FirstOrDefaultAsync; returns CertificateVerificationDto only — no PII; 410 if revoked). Program.cs: AddServiceDefaults, AddNpgsqlDbContext, AddBlobs, AddMassTransit (consumers from Infrastructure assembly), AddFeatureManagement, AddCertificateInfrastructure, UseMiddleware<TenantMiddleware> only on /api/certificates branch via UseWhen — verify path must NOT require tenant. RFC7807 ProblemDetails for all errors with extensions.code per contracts.md.

tasks.title: AppHost wiring for CertificateService + storage blob container
tasks.spec: Edit src/LMS.AppHost/Program.cs per contracts.md section 8. Replace commented `// var certificateDb` line with `var certificateDb = postgres.AddDatabase("lms-certificate");`. Add `var certificatePdfs = storage.AddBlobs("certificate-pdfs");` near the existing storage definition. Add certificate-migrator + certificate project blocks with WaitForCompletion(certificateMigrator) and WaitFor(certificatePdfs); register `gateway.WithReference(certificate);`. Confirm gateway appsettings.json already has `certificate` and `verify` routes — DO NOT modify. No other changes.

tasks.title: Integration + architecture + contract tests
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md section 10. Add tests/LMS.IntegrationTests/CertificateService/ with Testcontainers Postgres + Azurite + RabbitMQ; reuse xunit-integration patterns. Cover: tenant isolation (A vs B 404/empty), CourseCompletedConsumer issues exactly once + idempotent on re-deliver + no-op when active cert exists + new issuance allowed after revoke, GET /pdf streams %PDF- + 410 when revoked, POST /revoke admin-only (instructor=403, double-revoke=409), GET /verify/{code} anonymous returns no PII + 410 on revoked + 404 on unknown. Architecture tests in LMS.ArchitectureTests: Certificate inherits TenantEntity, CertificateDbContext applies global TenantId filter, Api project does not reference Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer, only one method (named VerifyAsync) calls IgnoreQueryFilters. Contract test in LMS.ContractTests: CertificateIssued shape exactly matches spec.

tasks.title: Tenant-isolation + verify-endpoint security audit
tasks.spec: Run /audit-tenant scoped to src/services/LMS.CertificateService. Specific checks: (a) every Certificate read except VerifyAsync goes through tenant-filtered DbSet (no IgnoreQueryFilters elsewhere); (b) VerifyAsync response contains no UserId, TenantId, PdfStorageKey, RevocationReason; (c) GET /pdf enforces owner-or-admin and not just tenant scope; (d) POST /revoke is admin-only, not instructor; (e) CourseCompletedConsumer sets CurrentTenantId from msg.TenantId before any DB access; (f) blob keys include tenantId so cross-tenant blob enumeration is detectable in logs; (g) no Authorization header or X-User-Id read on /verify route. Produce findings; T11 reviewer must address any HIGH severity items before merge.

tasks.title: Final review against contracts.md + absolute rules
tasks.spec: Run /code-reviewer against all CertificateService changes (T1–T10). Mandatory checks: (1) Certificate inherits TenantEntity; (2) global EF filter present; (3) NO direct HTTP between services (no HttpClient targeting another LMS service); (4) JWT validated only at gateway, no AddJwtBearer in Api; (5) CertificateIssued declared in LMS.Contracts (not inline); (6) PDF generated via QuestPDF only (grep iTextSharp, Puppeteer, PdfSharp — must be absent); (7) port 5108 set in launchSettings; (8) Aspire resource name 'certificate' matches gateway cluster; (9) verify endpoint anonymous and PII-free; (10) revoke is admin-only. Address all HIGH-severity findings from T10. Block merge on any contract drift.
